SELECT o.*, u.nickname AS user_nickname FROM orders o LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE o.is_deleted = 0
AND o.status = #{status}
AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%')
ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM orders WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT oi.book_title AS title, SUM(oi.quantity) AS sales, SUM(oi.price * oi.quantity) AS amount FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id AND o.is_deleted = 0 AND o.status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY oi.book_id, oi.book_title ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
